missing_credential.behavior: FAIL_CLOSED with clear error explanation, zero secret leaked

provider_unavailable_5xx.behavior: Circuit breaker triggers cooldown -> Instant failover to secondary provider

provider_quota_429.behavior: Quota-Aware deprioritization -> Fallback to healthy model / Groq absorber

invalid_input.behavior: HTTP 400 / Validation error with structured payload

unsupported_format.behavior: Rejected safely before memory/AST ingestion with format list

network_timeout.behavior: 15s/30s strict timeout -> Circuit breaker failure increment -> Fallback
